SELECT DISTINCT a.activity_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.standard_relation, a.assay_id, a2.assay_type, a2.assay_organism, a2.assay_tax_id, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id, cr.compound_name, cs.canonical_smiles, d.title AS literature_title
FROM activities a
INNER JOIN assays a2 ON a.assay_id = a2.assay_id
INNER JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2.tid = td.tid
INNER JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
INNER JOIN compound_structures cs ON cr.molregno = cs.molregno
INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
INNER JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE a.standard_relation = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND a2.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'
  AND td.tid = 3879801
  AND md.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL493620'
ORDER BY a.standard_value ASC, cr.compound_name ASC;
